screen.relics_addon.battery_rf.hint: Charge with any FE charger, or put a charged FE item into the charge slot. A switched-off battery does not power the device.
screen.relics_addon.battery_mana.hint: Refills while the device is on: from Botania mana items, your Ars Nouveau or Iron's Spells mana, or your experience.
screen.relics_addon.charge_slot.hint: A charged FE item placed here pours its energy into the RF battery. It is returned when the console closes.
tooltip.relics_addon.hold_shift: Hold Shift to open its console
screen.relics_addon.toggle.hint: Turns the device on or off. It also needs charge in a switched-on battery to work.
screen.relics_addon.module_hint: Drag a Device Module into a bay. Craft: amethyst shard, redstone, iron nugget.
screen.relics_addon.battery_toggle.hint: A switched-off battery keeps its charge but does not power the device.
screen.relics_addon.mana_source.auto.hin: Magic mods first (Botania items, Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells), then your experience.
screen.relics_addon.mana_source.magic.hi: Only mana: Botania tablets and rings, your Ars Nouveau or Iron's Spells mana.
screen.relics_addon.swarm_hint: Healers restore your health and never attack. Every other drone defends you and attacks your target.
screen.relics_addon.experience.hint: Earned by absorbing damage and fighting. Each level gives an upgrade point.
screen.relics_addon.help:
Overview: switch the device on, watch its integrity and charge, and drag modules into the three bays.
Batteries: RF charges from any FE charger or the charge slot; mana refills from magic mods or experience. Each battery has its own switch.
Upgrades: spend the points you earn per level.
Swarm (hives): split drones between fighters and healers.
The line on the left is experience to the next level. Hold Shift over a device in any inventory to open this console.
